regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: This species is fairly widespread in the western Amazon basin and has been recorded in the Ríos Yavarí (Javary), Itaya, Nanay, Carahuayte, Tamaya, Ampiyacu, and Ucayali in Peru, the Ríos Aguarico and Napo in Ecuador, and the rio Solimões in Brazil.
